results.claim: The signed reference oracle avoids signed 32-bit INT_MIN/-1 overflow by widening both operands to int64_t before division, then keeps and sign-extends the low word.
The generated wrappers use argument order from pinned DIV/DIVU/DIV1/DIVU1 translator templates and source-pinned GPR_U32/GPR_S32 macros.
Each operation is tested for 600,600 samples with zero observed baseline mismatches, and each quotient-bit-flipped negative-control operation reports 600,600 mismatches.
The zero-divisor result is validated only against the pinned software policy; the evidence does not claim a Sony hardware-defined result.
